map.输入催化前后 CO、HC、NOx 浓度，计算各成分催化转换效率及综合评价。: Enter CO, HC and NOx concentrations upstream and downstream of the catalyst to compute each component's conversion efficiency plus an overall assessment.
map.氧化能力下降、空燃比异常: Degraded oxidation capacity, abnormal air-fuel ratio
map.还原能力下降、富氧工况过多: Degraded reduction capacity, excessive lean running
map.含铅或高硫燃油会造成涂层中毒；长期缺火使未燃混合气在催化器内二次燃烧、高温烧熔载: Leaded or high-sulfur fuel poisons the washcoat; prolonged misfire makes unburned mixture burn inside the converter and melt the substrate; phosphorus and zinc deposits from oil consumption also cover the active sites.
map.📉 前后氧传感器交叉验证: 📉 Cross-Checking Upstream and Downstream O2 Sensors
map.催化器正常时下游氧传感器信号应比上游平稳得多。若前后信号趋于一致（下游也频繁波动: With a healthy catalyst the downstream O2 sensor signal should be far steadier than upstream. If the two signals converge (the downstream one also swings often), the catalyst has lost oxygen storage capacity, typically matching P0420/P0430.
map.💡 效率判定须在热车、闭环工况下采集，冷启动阶段催化器尚未起燃，效率必然偏低，不: 💡 Judge efficiency only on a hot engine in closed loop; before light-off during cold start efficiency is naturally low, which is no proof of failure.
map.年检或维修诊断时，采集催化器前、后排气中 CO、HC、NOx 浓度，计算各成分转: At annual inspection or repair diagnosis, sample CO, HC and NOx upstream and downstream of the catalyst and compute conversion efficiency to judge failure.
map.氧传感器数据异常时，用前后浓度差定位催化器是否老化或堵塞。: When O2 sensor data looks odd, use the concentration difference across the converter to locate aging or clogging.
map.排放整改或教学实验里，对比不同工况下的转化效率，评估三效催化器工作状态。: In emissions remediation or teaching labs, compare conversion efficiency under different conditions to assess three-way catalyst condition.
map.催化器前 HC=120ppm、后 HC=18ppm；转化效率 η=(前−后)/前: Upstream HC=120ppm, downstream HC=18ppm; conversion efficiency η=(Before−After)/Before×100%=(120−18)/120×100%=85%. A healthy three-way catalyst should exceed 90% for HC and CO and 80% for NOx; significantly lower values point to aging or failure.
map.效率多少算催化器坏了？: At what efficiency is the converter considered dead?
map.经验上 HC/CO 转化效率低于约 90%、NOx 低于约 80%，或前后氧传感: As a rule of thumb, HC/CO conversion below about 90% and NOx below about 80%, or converging upstream/downstream O2 signals (meaning no catalysis), indicate excessive converter loss. Exact thresholds follow the vehicle and regulatory test, judged together with codes P0420/P0430.
map.加劣质油会伤催化器吗？: Does poor-quality fuel damage the catalyst?
map.会。含铅或高硫燃油会覆盖催化涂层、永久中毒失活；燃烧不完全产生的过量积碳也可能堵: Yes. Leaded or high-sulfur fuel coats the washcoat and permanently poisons it; excess carbon from incomplete combustion can also clog the substrate. Using the correct grade of clean fuel and avoiding misfire (unburned mixture melts the core) extends its life.
map.须在热车闭环工况下采集，冷启动阶段催化器未起燃，效率偏低属正常: Sample hot and in closed loop; before light-off during cold start the efficiency is low, which is normal
